gaps.explanation: Statement transfers_in 25,010 is the p4 Total column, which is net of eliminations: General Transfers in 78,292 - Eliminations 53,282 = 25,010 (the 25,010 comes from the Water Fund, p6 transfers (25,010)). Detail holds Rescue 5,070 (p10). Part 1, missing fund column: the General column's Transfers in 78,292 (p4) is not in detail - added below. Part 2, different basis: after the add, detail transfers in = 5,070 + 78,292 = 83,362 gross per fund; 83,362 - 25,010 = 58,352 = transfers between governmental funds (Sales Tax 40,000 + Pool 11,700 + Equipment Sinking 1,582 into General = 53,282 eliminated, plus General 5,070 into Rescue, netted inside the Other Governmental Funds column (8,212)). Gross vs netted Total column: no further fix.
